search_window.basis: Prior verified hourly Care Line Watch completion through current observation. Supplemental recall only; production collection authoritative.

coverage_notes.scope: U.S. states, DC, and territories; hospital/ED/obstetrics/behavioral health/dialysis/oncology/primary care closures or suspensions, emergency and rural care loss, ambulance/air-medical/base loss, CMS terminations/CLIA limits/rescissions, and concrete essential-service restorations.

cms_public_notices.result: Official CMS listing had no October 31 dated notices; its seven October 30 provider terminations were recorded by previous watches. No newly dated CMS termination, rescission, CLIA suspension or limitation was shown.

coverage_notes.result_summary: CMS check and all 12 additional targeted searches completed. No new verified, nonduplicate qualifying healthcare-access change or effective essential-service reopening identified in current interval.
coverage_notes.limitations: The hourly recall search is not exhaustive; indexing delays, very small rural services, and territories may be missed. Existing older official closure announcements are candidates for production reconciliation but are not falsely classified as new hourly developments. Production collector remains authoritative.
coverage_notes.controls: One private watch-ledger heartbeat only. No public publication, approvals, scheduled-task modification, or disabling.
